common_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
boot_unreachable_body: Check that Beamhop is running and that you're online, then try again.
offline_banner: You're offline. Showing what was loaded last.
action_shown_once: Save this now. It won't be shown again.
action_undo_hint: You can undo this for a few minutes after applying.
tt_goals_hint: Move a slider, then review what changes before it applies.
config_review_desc: Here's exactly what will change, in plain words.
config_undo_note: You can undo this for 5 minutes.
why_explainer: This usually means the server refused the request or could not be reached. Nothing was changed.
why_no_details: Turn on “Show technical details” in Settings to see more.
why_unavailable: No explanation is available for this yet.
lens_desc: Reveal protocol terms, event kinds and raw values next to the plain wording.
kbd_goto: Go to Home, Activity, People, Media, Settings
kbd_keep: Keep (review queue) · dismiss the Home card
signin_subtitle: Manage your relay with your Nostr key or a passkey.
signin_extension_failed: Your Nostr extension didn't respond. Unlock it and try again.
signin_bunker: Sign in with a remote signer
signin_bunker_auth: Your signer asks you to approve this sign-in:
signin_no_extension: No Nostr browser extension found. Use a remote signer (like nsec.app or Amber) or a passkey.
wizard_claim_body: Enter the one-time code printed in your server's terminal. Whoever claims the relay becomes its owner.
wizard_claim_signin: Then choose how you'll sign in
wizard_persona_title: What kind of relay is this?
wizard_persona_body: Pick the closest fit. Beamhop sets sensible defaults for you.
wizard_persona_later: You can change this any time in Settings.
wizard_domain_body: Which domain should your relay answer on? You can skip this and add it later.
wizard_tls_acme: Beamhop gets and renews certificates for you automatically.
wizard_tls_proxy: A proxy in front of Beamhop handles secure connections.
wizard_tls_off: Secure connections are off. Fine for testing; turn them on before going public.
wizard_tls_unknown: We couldn't check the connection right now.
wizard_done_body: Share these addresses with your community.
wizard_qr_label: QR code for the relay address
recovery_body: If you ever lose your key or passkey, one of these codes gets you back in as owner. Each works once. Keep them somewhere safe, like a password manager.
recovery_file_header: Beamhop owner recovery codes. Each code works once.
recovery_none_here: Your recovery codes were shown when the relay was claimed. You can create new ones in Settings → Sign-in & recovery.
push_denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings.
push_unsupported: This browser can't receive alerts. Install the app to your home screen and try again.
push_unavailable: Phone alerts aren't available on this server yet.
persona_public_desc: Anyone can join and post. Spam filters and fair-use limits keep it healthy.
persona_team_desc: Only invited people can read and post. Everything is kept.
persona_wot_desc: People you follow, and people they trust, can post.
persona_media_desc: Generous file sizes, thumbnails and video conversion.
persona_org_desc: Members only, sign-in required, long retention.
cards_swipe_hint: Swipe right to approve, left for later
tile_connections_help: People connected to your relay right now.
tile_events_help: New posts your relay accepted, averaged over 5 seconds.
tile_errors_help: Refused posts and server errors in the last few minutes.
tile_window: Last 3 minutes, one point every 5 seconds.
tile_no_data: No data yet. Numbers appear as your relay gets traffic.
insights_intro: How your relay is doing right now, and who uses it. Tap “Why?” next to any number.
insights_absent: Charts need the insights module, which is not turned on for this server.
insights_privacy: All of this is counted on your server and never sent anywhere.
insights_reasons_let_in: {percent}% of posts were let in during the last minute.
insights_reasons_none: Nothing was refused in the last minute.
insights_chart_empty: No data yet. The chart fills in as your relay gets traffic.
insights_community_off: Community statistics are turned off. You can turn them on in Settings → Privacy.
insights_retention_hint: Each row is the week people first showed up. Columns show the share active again 1, 2, 3… weeks later.
insights_geo_privacy: Counted by country only, as reported by your host. IP addresses are never stored.
insights_geo_off: Counting visitors by country is off.
launch_intro: Everything you need to tell people about your relay.
launch_qr_label: QR code for your relay address
launch_announce_hint: A draft to post from your own Nostr app. Beamhop never posts it for you.
launch_polish_hint: Apps show these when people look at your relay.
launch_test_hint: Checks from the outside that people can connect, post, read and upload.
launch_needs_domain: Add your web address first, then come back to share your relay.
launch_absent: The launch kit is not available on this server.
goalov_revert: Go back to the goal’s value
goalov_revert_summary: Went back to the goal’s value
goalov_advanced_hint: Each value comes from one of your goals. Values you changed yourself keep your number until you go back.
stream_empty: Nothing yet. New activity shows up here as it happens.
live_post_held: Held a post from {who} for review
mod_removed: Removed. It's in the recycle bin.
mod_hint: Swipe → keep · ← remove · ↑ block author · ↓ skip
bin_note: Removed items are kept for a while, then deleted for good.
alerts_fallback: Showing current warnings and recent errors.
act_ai_only_hint: An AI suggestion. Nothing happens unless you decide.
act_bulk_nothing: None of the selected items can be changed this way.
act_bulk_skipped: {count} selected items are not included (they have no post or author).
act_bulk_pending: Sent to another admin for approval. Nothing changes until they approve.
act_refused_empty: No refused posts since the server started.
act_logs_unavailable: Logs are not available on this server.
act_logs_privacy: IP addresses and secrets are hidden.
act_logs_empty: Nothing matches. Try more levels or a longer time.
act_digest_desc: A short report on how your relay is doing, sent to your alert channels.
act_digest_tips_desc: One short tip on running your relay in each summary.
act_oncall_desc: Admins take turns. Urgent alerts go to whoever is on duty.
act_oncall_unavailable: Turn on alerts to set an on-call schedule.
act_oncall_none: Nobody is on call — alerts go to everyone.
act_oncall_empty: No turns yet. Add someone to start a rotation.
act_oncall_repeats: Then it starts again from the top.
act_oncall_no_channels: Add an alert channel first, so the person on duty can be reached.
act_notes_placeholder: Write a note for the team
people_derived_note: People who posted or uploaded recently.
ppl_select_hint: Long-press a row (or use Select) to act on several people
ppl_sec_checklist: Can you always get back in?
ppl_sec_checklist_desc: If you lose your key, any one of these lets you back in.
ppl_sec_owners_desc: Owners can do everything, including adding or removing other owners. A second owner can let you back in.
ppl_sec_only_owner: You are the only owner. If you lose your key and your codes, nobody can get in.
ppl_sec_swipe_hint: Swipe a token to revoke it
notes_private: Only your admin team can see these.
notes_placeholder: Add a note for the team
invite_member_desc: A code that lets someone post here
invite_admin_desc: A code that adds someone to your admin team
invites_note: Invite codes you create appear here so you can copy them.
access_mode_allowlist: Only members you add or invite
access_mode_wot: People in your web of trust
media_tiers_off: Older files stay in main storage. Add cheaper storage in settings to move them automatically.
media_tiers_rule: Files nobody opened for {days} days move to cheaper storage.
media_tiers_error: The cheaper storage is not reachable.
media_notes_empty: No notes yet. Notes are only seen by your team.
media_notes_placeholder: Add a note for your team
settings_persona_pick_desc: You'll see exactly what changes before anything is applied.
settings_goals_desc: Openness, spam, storage, media and speed
section_relay_info_desc: Name, description and your landing page
backups_intro: Your backups, newest first. Check one to be sure it is complete, or restore it to go back in time.
backups_off_hint: Turn them on to keep copies of your posts, media lists and settings.
backups_never: No backups yet. Make the first one now.
backups_manual_only: Automatic backups are off. You can still back up by hand.
backups_check_ok: This backup is complete and undamaged
backups_restore_owner: Only the owner can restore a backup.
backups_found_hint: Backups this server did not make, for example from before a move. You can still restore them.
backups_standby_off: Off. A standby server keeps a live copy and takes over within minutes if this one fails.
backups_cleanup_hint: Removes posts older than your keep-for rules
backups_settings_hint: How often, how many to keep and where they go
section_advanced_desc: Exact limits; anything set here overrides your goals
goals_intro: Tell Beamhop what you want; it works out the exact limits. Move a slider to see what changes before you save.
goals_move_hint: Move a slider to preview its effect.
goals_no_effect: This doesn't change any limits on its own.
goals_see_exact: See or override the exact limits
history_desc: Every change ever made. Tap a point to see what restoring it would change.
history_restore_desc: Restoring makes these changes. You can undo it for 5 minutes.
security_recovery_desc: One-time codes that let an owner back in after losing their key or passkey.
security_recovery_unsaved: You haven't confirmed saving your recovery codes on this device.
security_passkeys_desc: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN.
security_tokens_desc: Keys for scripts and automation. They can only do what you allow, and they expire.
help_shortcuts: Tip: press ? anywhere to see keyboard shortcuts.
section_privacy_desc: Visitor data, status page and the assistant
config_simulate_desc: See what this change would have done to the last day of posts. Nothing is changed.
screen_fallback: That screen isn't in this app, so you're on {tab} instead.
assistant_desc: Ask how your relay is doing. It can suggest changes; nothing changes until you approve.
assistant_off_body: Turn it on in Settings › Privacy & public pages. It is off by default and can run on your own server.
assistant_off_body_ask: AI is off. Ask an owner to turn it on in Settings › Privacy & public pages.
assistant_suggest_change: Is there anything I should change?
assistant_never_applies: Suggestions change nothing until you approve them.
assistant_bad_proposal: This suggestion can't be applied from here.
cards_dismissed: Dismissed. It comes back only if something new happens.
channels_empty: No channels yet. Add one so Beamhop can reach you.
channels_add_desc: Pick how Beamhop should reach you.
channel_help_webpush: Alerts as notifications on this phone or computer.
channel_help_nostr_dm: An encrypted direct message to a Nostr account.
channel_help_telegram: Create a bot with @BotFather, add it to your chat, then paste its token and the chat id.
channel_help_discord: In Discord: channel settings › Integrations › Webhooks › New webhook › Copy URL.
channel_help_slack: In Slack: create an incoming webhook for a channel and paste its URL.
channel_help_email: Who gets the email, and the mail server Beamhop sends it through.
channel_webpush_note: After you apply, this device asks for permission to show notifications. Other admins turn it on from their own device.
channel_err_pubkey: Enter an npub or a 64-character hex key
channel_err_telegram_token: This doesn't look like a bot token (123456:ABC…)
key_option: Sign in with your private key
key_safer: A browser extension or remote signer is safer: with them your key never touches this page. Your key stays in this tab's memory only and is never sent to the server.
key_remember_desc: Your key is saved on this device, locked with a password you choose. Anyone with this device and the password can sign in.
key_remember_same: Your key is saved on this device, locked with the same password.
key_memory_only: Signing happens on this device. Close the tab to forget the key.
key_password_short: Use a password with at least {min} characters.
key_is_public: That is a public key (npub). Paste your private key (nsec) instead.
key_invalid: That doesn't look like a private key. Paste an nsec1…, ncryptsec1… or 64-character hex key.
key_wrong_password: Wrong password, or the key could not be unlocked.
key_unlock_desc: A key is saved on this device, locked with your password.
security_device_stored: Your private key is saved here, locked with your password. Forget it if others use this device.
security_device_none: No private key is saved on this device.
security_device_forgotten: Saved key removed from this device
system_summary: Version, one-tap updates, setup check and machine advice
system_intro: Keep Beamhop up to date, check this setup and see what machine it needs.
system_update_unknown: Could not check for updates right now.
system_update_unavailable: Updates are not available from the app on this server.
system_cloudflare_how: Updates on Cloudflare happen through `npm create beamhop -- --cf` again or your deploy pipeline.
system_update_safety: Beamhop backs up your data first and goes back by itself if the new version is not healthy.
system_offline_note: The server is restarting. This page reconnects by itself.
system_server_gone: The server has not come back after the restart. Check it on the machine (beamhop doctor).
system_rolled_back: Went back to the previous version
system_rolling_back: Going back to the previous version…
system_backup_offer: A backup from just before the update is kept. Restoring it loses changes made since then.
system_restore_backup: Restore data from before the update
system_previous_kept: Version {version} is kept in case you want to go back.
system_doctor_running: Checking DNS, certificate, ports, proxy, disk and more…
system_doctor_unavailable: The setup check could not run.
system_doctor_partial: Only the health checks ran; the full setup check needs the Beamhop program on a server.
system_advisor_none: Nothing to change: this machine fits your relay.
test_needs_domain_body: Your relay has no public address yet, so it can't be tested from the internet. Add your domain, then test again.
goals_quota_over: {count} people would be over their new storage limit
goals_quota_over_one: 1 person would be over their new storage limit
goals_quota_near: {count} more would be close to it
goals_quota_near_one: 1 more would be close to it
plugins_intro: Add extra rules and features. New plugins arrive turned off so you can review them first.
plugins_unavailable: Plugins aren't available on this server.
plugins_safety_body: Beamhop switched it off because {reason}. Everything else keeps working. Turn it back on, or remove it.
plugins_none: No plugins yet. Add one from the list below.
plugins_review_hint: Turned off. Check its settings, then turn it on.
plugins_remote_error: The online plugin list could not be loaded; showing built-in plugins.
plugins_no_permissions: It can't read your data, save anything or go online.
plugins_added_off: You'll see what a plugin may do before it is added. It starts turned off.
plugins_json_help: This plugin has no settings form. Edit its settings as JSON.
plugins_json_invalid: That is not a valid settings object.
plugin_writer_entry_hint: Describe a rule in your own words. The assistant writes and tests it; you review it before it does anything.
plugin_writer_placeholder: Describe what the plugin should do, e.g. 'Refuse posts with more than 5 links from people who joined this week'
plugin_writer_example_links: Refuse posts with more than 5 links from people who joined this week
plugin_writer_example_nsfw: Hold posts tagged nsfw for review instead of publishing them
plugin_writer_example_night: Slow down people who post more than 20 times an hour
plugin_writer_safe_note: Nothing changes yet. The plugin is tested first and added turned off.
plugin_writer_generating: Writing the plugin and testing it…
plugin_writer_generating_hint: This can take a minute. You can close this and come back.
plugin_writer_ready: Your plugin is ready to review in Plugins.
plugin_writer_failed_title: The plugin could not be written
plugin_writer_installed_off: Installed, turned off. Review it, then turn it on.
plugin_writer_enabled: It's on. It checks new activity from now on.
plugin_writer_tests_none: It wasn't tested on this server.
plugin_writer_perm_none: Nothing. It can't read your data, save anything or go online.
plugin_writer_perm_read: Read posts and profiles stored on this relay
plugin_writer_perm_write: Publish new posts to this relay on its own
plugin_writer_perm_network: Connect to other websites and servers
plugin_writer_perm_docs: Keep its own saved data on this server
plugin_writer_perm_approval: It gets this access only after you approve it.
plugin_writer_allowed: Access allowed. It uses it once the plugin is on.
plugin_writer_allow_owner: Only the owner can allow this access.
plugin_writer_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text instead.
plugin_writer_block_tests: It can't be turned on: some of its checks failed.
plugin_writer_block_untested: It can't be turned on here: it wasn't tested.
plugin_writer_block_not_installed: It can't be turned on: it wasn't added to this server.
plugin_writer_why_title: Why can't I turn it on?
plugin_writer_why_tests: Plugins only go live when every check passes. These didn't:
plugin_writer_why_next: Try again and describe the rule more precisely, for example who it applies to and what should happen.
company_intro: Let people sign in with their work account, and decide what each group in your company may do.
company_turn_on_body: Let your team sign in with Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra or another provider. You'll see exactly what changes before it's turned on.
company_cannot_enable: This server can't turn the feature on from the app. Ask whoever runs it to enable company sign-in.
company_step_setup: 2. Set up the app in your provider
company_test_hint: Connect your provider first, then test it here.
company_groups_desc: Decide what people in each company group get: relay access, plan, admin role and how their keys are handled.
company_groups_empty: No groups yet. Everyone who signs in gets the default access.
wizard_org_body: Connect your company directory so people sign in with their work account. We'll set up a members-only relay with sign-in required.
wizard_org_later: You can skip this and finish it later in Settings › Company sign-in.
company_scim_existing: A user sync token ending in …{last4} already exists.
